_comment: Witnesses for tests/unit/costs/test_first_activation_each_turn.py. `t_fae_tezzeret` carries Tezzeret, Betrayer of Flesh's first line on an enchantment, so nothing else about a planeswalker is in the way. `t_fae_engine` is an artifact with a repeatable {3}: draw ability (no tap), so two activations of one permanent can be priced in a row; `t_fae_rune` is the same ability on an enchantment, the non-artifact near miss. Sol Ring (tap-only mana, which the payment solver activates) and Dimir Signet ({1}, {T}: by-hand mana) are the shipped artifacts whose mana abilities count.
